skills.name: product-integrity
skills.purpose: Each listed product has what the site needs and nothing it cannot prove: an owner, a title, its own store link, a real photo; no rating/review/sales field, no price without an approved source.

skills.name: link-health
skills.purpose: Every purchase link is a well-formed https store link of its own. Links are not opened: an affiliate link would count a click, and the store may answer with a CAPTCHA, which we never work around.

skills.name: price-freshness
skills.purpose: Each price has an approved source and a recent check, or is shown as 'the current price is at the store'. Never invents a price.

skills.name: media-matching
skills.purpose: Every image and video is tied to the product it shows: MATCHED only with evidence (a person's check, an upload for that product), REJECTED when it shows another item, UNCERTAIN otherwise.

skills.name: discovery-ranking
skills.purpose: An explainable product order from data quality (own store link, checked video, clean image, checked price) — never popularity, ratings or sales.

skills.name: content-production
skills.purpose: Claim-free Hebrew hooks, a storyboard and a disclosed caption per publishable product, ready for the existing renderers. It renders nothing itself and never says a video exists.
